method: One bounded falsification slice. Starting from r197's freshness-nonreuse requirement, compare repository-derived creation identities under copy, delete/recreate and exact historical resurrection. Identity candidates tested: receipt path alone; path plus content-addressed blob object id; creation-commit object id. Admission model is equality to the current incarnation identity, with one stale writer carrying the old identity.

public_sources.title: Pro Git 10.2 Git Objects
public_sources.relevance: Git is content-addressable; object names are checksums of stored content plus header, so exact receipt content recreation reuses the same blob identity.

public_sources.title: Pro Git 10.3 Git References
public_sources.relevance: Refs are movable pointers to object ids and can be updated to earlier commits; a repository path or reachable creation commit is therefore not intrinsically a non-reused incarnation token.

candidate_revision: A role-local immutable creation receipt/path is useful provenance but is not by itself a non-reused incarnation identity across restore/clone. Path identity is replayable; path+blob identity is content-addressed and therefore repeats under exact-content recreation; creation-commit identity changes on an ordinary new commit but repeats under clone or exact historical resurrection. Preventing these reuses requires an additional freshness source or an append-only external uniqueness invariant, neither of which is supplied by the receipt/path itself.

comparison.receipt_path: lowest integration cost and zero incremental cost, but fails copy/delete-recreate/rollback freshness
comparison.path_plus_blob_oid: strong integrity binding but same freshness failure under exact content
comparison.creation_commit_oid: stronger for ordinary recreate-on-new-history, but still fails clone and exact historical resurrection
comparison.next_candidate: fresh locally minted nonce plus predecessor binding; probabilistic freshness assumption must be explicit and compared against deterministic repository-derived identity

tested_scope: Deterministic synthetic single logical pointer, one stale writer, equality-based admission, role-local receipt path/blob/creation-commit identities, clone/copy, delete-and-exact-content-recreate, and exact historical resurrection. Public Git object/reference semantics only. No live repository mutation experiment, multi-object atomicity, network partition, protected coordination, server audit-log uniqueness, real randomness/collision probability, identity forgery, branch protection, garbage-collection guarantees, or cryptographic collision behavior tested.

Test whether a Chat-native, zero-monthly-quota freshness source can guarantee non-reuse without protected coordination; if only probabilistic, quantify the assumption and failure bound.
Keep multi-object atomicity and network-partition semantics outside accepted scope until a later dedicated leaf.
